title: The breakup of his marriage and his weakness for women
summary: He nearly had a breakdown after the divorce; he did not drink or smoke pot much but chased women until joining Cab.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Uh huh. So you stayed with Helen for 25 years, and what did you digress to from there?

Well, I almost had a nervous breakdown after that marriage broke up. I feel in a way, that I was partly responsible for some of the things that happened, because like I said in the beginning before I joined Cab Calloway's band, that I was a pretty wild little guy; I wasn't a big drinker and I couldn't smoke pot because -- marijuana -- because it put me to sleep -- when everyone else was getting high and feeling good, I went to sleep, so I could never smoke it.
And Cab didn't allow it in his band.

Right, Cab didn't allow it in his band, anyhow, and I wasn't a big drinker, because I could suffer with a hangover worse than anybody you ever saw. So my weakness was the girls. Yeah, I loved the girls, you know? So this was one of the problems that Helen had with me in the early part of our marriage.

But like I said, after I joined Cab's band, I really cooled down to the stage where there was nobody else but her, although at the time, it was too late -- I think the horse was out of the barn, because she didn't believe it.
